description: Update customer note, email and tags (customerUpdate). dryRun:true (the default) returns the current customer and the change without applying it; dryRun:false applies it and returns before and after. Tags: addTags and removeTags change only the named tags; replaceTags replaces all tags. Email marketing consent is out of scope. Requires write_customers.

addTags.description: Tags to add (tagsAdd). Other tags are kept.

dryRun.description: True (the default) returns a before/after preview without changing anything in Shopify. Pass false to apply the change; the tool then reads the result back.

removeTags.description: Tags to remove (tagsRemove). Other tags are kept.

replaceTags.description: Replaces all tags: every current tag not in this list is removed. Prefer addTags or removeTags.

name: shopify_update_customer
